fact: On 24 September 2024 the education ministry closed enrolment on the X-Gest application and, on the minister's instruction and as a protective measure, ordered that no personal data, school results included, should pass through the X-Gest platform any longer, after irregularities in pupils' enrolment and re-enrolment on it since the start of school year 2024-2025.
title: Éducation nationale : fermeture des inscriptions sur l'application X-Gest
